---
name: Skill defect
about: A skill's content is wrong, contradictory, or unsafe to follow
title: "[skill-name] short description"
labels: bug
---

**Skill**
Path: `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` (and section, if applicable)

**What the skill says**
Quote the problematic text.

**Why it is wrong**
Factually incorrect, internally contradictory, contradicts another skill it
names, grants authority a skill cannot grant, or is unsafe for an agent to
follow. Be specific.

**Expected content**
What the text should say instead, if you have a proposal.
